newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia holds NYSE gains at Helsinki open.
newsitem.headline: Nokia holds NYSE gains at Helsinki open.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy maintained overnight gains in New York at the Helsinki bourse opening on Friday.
At 1035/0735 GMT, Nokia traded at 215.10 -- a new nine-month high -- up 5.10 markka or 2.40 percent versus Thursday's close. Trade was lively at over 20 million markka right at the start.
In New York, Nokia closed up $1-3/4 at $47-1/4, which corresponded to 215.80 markka.
But brokers expected trade to calm down since it is Friday and since trend-setting U.S. September payrolls data is due later, at 1230 GMT.
"Always when there are big price adjustment between our close and the New York close, it is normal that there will be orders left over which are executed," one broker said.
"There is nothing exciting here now," he said, adding that there was little potential for further gains in Nokia.
Nokia started rising stronly on Wednesday and built on gains after it announced a major deal with U.S. operator AT&T.
